notes:
Changes since v0.2.157

- Each design tab has its own close button, with the new-tab button beside the tab strip.
- Menus use shorter labels and move object actions to the right-click menu. Toolbar commands return to menus when unpinned.
- Help > Resource Guide opens seven searchable offline pages, including bag tags, foam, and an editable practice badge.
- Ask Stitchfits uses a smaller window with transparent edges, gives directions based on the current toolbar layout, and explains how to pin tools. Replies can open guide pages or copy your question.
- Lettering has a simpler layout with stitch and spacing controls under Advanced.
- Blocks previews both guide lines and shows the width in millimeters.

Save any open designs before updating.
